all designed or purchased (non-developmental items) facilities, systems, subsystems, and
equipment that emit acoustic noise or contain sources of noise.

qualifiers.exact_text: that emit acoustic noise or contain sources of noise.

Fixed physical plant facilities, such as real estate and
improvements thereto, and permanent habitable real property structures are covered under other
DoD policy and standards.

statement.subject: This standard
statement.action: establishes acoustic noise limits
statement.exact_text:
This standard establishes acoustic noise limits and prescribes testing
requirements and measurement procedures for determining conformance to the noise limits
stated herein.

qualifiers.exact_text:
Acoustical noise limits for determining conformance to community annoyance
requirements are beyond the scope of this standard.

critical_facts: equal to or above 140 dBP

Areas with impulsive levels equal to or above 140 dBP
shall be posted with noise hazard signs;

statement.subject: Areas with impulsive levels equal to or above 140 dBP
statement.action: be posted with noise hazard signs
statement.exact_text:
Areas with impulsive levels equal to or above 140 dBP
shall be posted with noise hazard signs;

qualifiers.exact_text: equal to or above 140 dBP

statement.subject: Systems and subsystems
statement.action:
be procured using the
design order of precedence in MIL-STD-882
statement.exact_text:
Systems and subsystems shall be procured using the
design order of precedence in MIL-STD-882 by eliminating hazards through design selection,
incorporating safety devices, providing warning devices, and developing procedures and
training.

statement.subject: Subsystems, sets, groups, and units
statement.action:
be
selected, integrated, and installed
statement.exact_text:
Subsystems, sets, groups, and units including such items as
air conditioners, heaters, input/output devices, printers, and auxiliary equipment, shall be
selected, integrated, and installed in such a manner that noise produced by the entire system does
not exceed the requirements of this standard.

qualifiers.exact_text:
in such a manner that noise produced by the entire system does
not exceed the requirements of this standard.

statement.subject: Both individual equipment and components
statement.action:
be selected
and designed for noise control
statement.exact_text:
Both individual equipment and components shall be selected
and designed for noise control.

statement.subject: Selection and design criteria for specific system components
statement.action: specify acceptable levels or preferred ranges of noise
statement.exact_text:
Selection and design criteria for specific system components or
“stand-alone” products shall specify acceptable levels or preferred ranges of noise for
components (e.g., pumps, fans, compressors, generators).

statement.subject: These
statement.action:
be specified as noise
levels measured under standard conditions or sound power levels
statement.exact_text:
These shall be specified as noise
levels measured under standard conditions or sound power levels, estimated from noise
measurements.

statement.subject: Procurement evaluation criteria
statement.action:
include the contribution of noise as a
selection criterion
statement.exact_text:
Procurement evaluation criteria shall include the contribution of noise as a
selection criterion in purchase decisions where the system may create hazardous exposure to
noise.

qualifiers.exact_text:
where the system may create hazardous exposure to
noise.

statement.subject: The use of GFE
statement.action:
eliminate the
requirement that the total system conform to this standard
statement.exact_text:
The use of GFE shall not eliminate the
requirement that the total system conform to this standard.

statement.subject: GFE causing the total system noise to
statement.action: be brought to the attention of the procuring activity
statement.exact_text:
GFE causing the total system noise to
exceed permissible levels shall be brought to the attention of the procuring activity.

qualifiers.exact_text:
causing the total system noise to
exceed permissible levels

statement.subject: Source noise reduction
statement.action:
be the primary
means to protect personnel from hazardous noise
statement.exact_text:
Source noise reduction shall be the primary
means to protect personnel from hazardous noise.

statement.subject:
Hearing protectors and administrative
measures such as warning signs
statement.action: be solely relied upon
statement.exact_text:
Hearing protectors and administrative
measures such as warning signs shall not be solely relied upon, unless all noise reduction design
approaches have been pursued.

qualifiers.exact_text:
unless all noise reduction design
approaches have been pursued.

statement.subject: Steady-state levels
statement.action: be less than 85 decibels A-weighted
statement.exact_text:
Steady-state levels shall be less than 85 decibels A-weighted
(dBA) and peak-pressure levels of impulsive noise less than 140 dBP, at the ear (protected or
unprotected), at all personnel locations during normal operations.

qualifiers.exact_text:
at the ear (protected or
unprotected)
at all personnel locations during normal operations.

statement.subject: the method specified in ANSI/ASA S12.68 or equivalent
statement.action:
be used
to compute the effective noise exposure
statement.exact_text:
Where personal protective equipment is used to
provide noise reduction, the method specified in ANSI/ASA S12.68 or equivalent shall be used
to compute the effective noise exposure using attenuation measured in accordance with
ANSI/ASA S12.6 and ANSI/ASA S12.42.

qualifiers.exact_text:
Where personal protective equipment is used to
provide noise reduction,

statement.subject: The method(s) used
statement.action: be documented
statement.exact_text: The method(s) used shall be documented.

statement.subject: They
statement.action:
be clearly visible and
legible
statement.exact_text:
They shall be clearly visible and
legible to all personnel that might be exposed to the hazard, to include crew and passengers.

qualifiers.exact_text: to all personnel that might be exposed to the hazard, to include crew and passengers.
This provision shall not apply to the exteriors of military combat equipment.
